# Build job: slice 2 (Step 2 Pricing, Step 3 Listing copy with the fair-housing pipeline, Step 4 Marketing plan)

Date 2026-10-23. Tag BUILD-2. Slice 1 is live at https://realestate.hughesnode.com (commits up to `ef8533f`): the
skeleton, record service and catalogue, Step 1 Intake, the first timeline, docker hosting through
`scripts/hosting.sh`, replays in `replays/`. Build slice 2 on top of it until its acceptance checks in
`docs/specs/poc-architecture.md` section 9 pass, then stop; slices 3 and 4 follow.

## Read first

`CLAUDE.md`; `docs/specs/poc-architecture.md` (all; sections 3, 5, 7 and 9 matter most); the amended
`docs/SUCCESS-CRITERIA.md` rows 2 to 4 and "Under the hood"; `docs/TRACEABILITY.md`; `docs/DECISIONS.md` 20 to 29;
`docs/specs/demo-house.md` and `fixtures/demo_house.json` (8 comparables); `docs/DEMO-SCRIPT.md`; the slice-1 code
and tests (read the code before adding to it, and follow its patterns).

## Do

1. **Step 2 Pricing:** at least 3 comparables from the fixtures, adjustments computed in code, the method in plain
   words, a range, the AI's recommended list price with its reasoning, the net sheet; the CP-25 "NY law today"
   marker; CP-05 the seller chooses the price and copy stays blocked until then. Labelled "Comparative market
   analysis, not an appraisal".
2. **Step 3 Listing copy:** MLS remarks, portal description, three social posts and a one-page flyer (PDF through
   WeasyPrint, DEMONSTRATION mark on every page). The **fair-housing pipeline** exactly as spec section 5 says:
   the written rules file (federal and NY protected classes, steering patterns, risky phrases), the model review
   pass, at least 40 fixtures of allowed and disallowed phrases with 100% recall on the disallowed ones, the visible
   checker panel with rule ID, class, legal basis and a fixed version, the "Plant a violation" button, re-check
   passes, and only passing copy marked "ready to publish" by the AI; the CP-06 marker; the MLS pre-check.
3. **Step 4 Marketing plan:** the channel board with every card's honest status from the connector stubs; CP-08
   "human required" (a licensed MLS participant keys the listing; no input API, linking to the WS3 finding on the
   review site); portals "fed from the MLS"; the rest as the spec says.
4. **Models:** run the spec's model side-by-side for these steps and settle `models.yaml`; record the replays the
   hosted demo needs so the demo house runs at no cost. Keep the app's own live spend within the spec's cap and
   say what it was.
5. Tests for all of it (fast, fake provider), including `test_no_unchecked_send` and the fixture recall test.
   Redeploy with `scripts/hosting.sh` and check the new screens on the live URL. Extend `docs/DEMO-SCRIPT.md` for
   steps 2 to 4 and set the traceability statuses.

## Rules

As in slice 1 (`docs/build/jobs/2026-10-23-slice-1.md`, "Rules"): PII baseline, fair-housing and never-scrape
rules, no owner name, the DEMONSTRATION mark, `git add <paths>` only for your files, commit at each working
milestone and push to `origin main`, run `bash scripts/disk-check.sh` before installs and image builds. If you run
out of budget mid-step, leave the tree committed and working at the last milestone.

## Finish

Final answer, under 300 words: acceptance checks passed and how each was checked, the fixture recall, the models
chosen, the app's live spend, anything deferred, and the last commit.
